name: chemoreceptor signal reception
description: Detection of a chemoeffector by a methyl-accepting chemoreceptor and its conversion into a conformational signal at the receptor's conserved cytoplasmic tip. The function is satisfied by any chemoreceptor; which chemoeffector is detected is a separate, narrower claim needing its own evidence.

name: chemotaxis kinase core
description: Autophosphorylation of the CheA histidine kinase under receptor control, which requires the CheW coupling protein to build the receptor-CheW-CheA array. CheV, a CheW-response regulator hybrid found alongside CheW in some Firmicutes, is not accepted as a substitute because it does not replace CheW in the systems where both occur.

name: chemotaxis response regulator
description: Phosphotransfer from CheA to the CheY response regulator, the diffusible messenger that carries the signal to the flagellar switch.

name: chemoreceptor adaptation
description: Reversible methylation of the chemoreceptor, which resets sensitivity so that the system responds to gradients rather than to absolute concentrations. Both the methyltransferase and the methylesterase are needed for the cycle to run in both directions.

name: chemotaxis signal termination
description: Dephosphorylation of CheY-P, which sets the response's decay time. It is curated as accessory because CheY-P also autodephosphorylates, and because the phosphatases are distributed unevenly: a genome without one still transduces a chemotactic signal, more slowly.

name: L-aspartate chemoreceptor signal reception
description: Detection of L-aspartate by the Tar chemoreceptor and its conversion into a signal at the receptor's cytoplasmic tip. This is a strictly narrower function than RF_CHEMOTAXIS_RECEPTION and takes strictly narrower evidence: a generic methyl-accepting chemotaxis protein accession is deliberately not accepted.

name: phosphate-limitation signal reception
description: Autophosphorylation of the PhoR sensor histidine kinase in response to phosphate limitation. The same sensor serves both curated circuits, which differ in their cognate response regulator.

name: PhoB transcriptional response
description: Phosphotransfer from PhoR to the PhoB response regulator, which activates Pho box promoters. This is the enterobacterial and pseudomonad form of the regulon's output.

name: PhoP transcriptional response
description: Phosphotransfer from PhoR to the PhoP response regulator of the Bacillus-type phosphate regulon. K07660, the response regulator of the magnesium-sensing PhoP/PhoQ system, is a different protein that happens to share the gene name and is deliberately not accepted.

name: phosphate status transduction complex
description: The PstSCAB transporter with PhoU, the complex through which the cell's phosphate status reaches PhoR. It is curated as accessory rather than required because it is independently a transport capability, and requiring it here would curate the same biology twice.
